    Transport of subspaces along letters and words #

    For a module M over an algebra with path data, the vertex space M_v is the image of e_v. A direct letter a pulls a subspace U back to the vectors of M_{s a} that a maps into U; an inverse letter a⁻¹ pushes U ∩ M_{s a} forward along a. Composing along a list C of letters gives C^* U: the vectors with a chain along C ending in U (Ringel's linear relations).
